tested_behaviors: successful run creates a receipt binding manifest, script, inputs, and output hashes
script hash mismatch and missing inputs refuse before child launch
fresh output collision preserves existing contents and refuses overwrite
exploratory jobs cannot claim confirmatory eligibility
hash-bound HUMAN_APPROVED record is checked but does not itself authorize confirmatory claims
invalid freeze protocol hash is refused
reported call, spend, wall-time, API-error, and judge-invalid limits stop the run

nonzero exit, missing required output, and input mutation are recorded as blocked
limitations: M-I remains OPEN; this is a local prototype, not full acceptance or an approved automatic execution surface.
Cost/call/error monitoring depends on the child emitting a cooperative append-only usage journal; it is not a provider meter or a hard spend cap.
The runner is not an OS sandbox; process-tree isolation and hostile-child containment are not established.
A local unsigned JSON HUMAN_APPROVED declaration is only checked for hash and shape; it is not authenticated human authority or scientific approval.
Not all malformed-manifest, concurrency, recovery, or platform-specific fixtures are covered; no real API job was launched.
The research repository has no configured remote; its commits are local and not available to collaborators until a verified remote is configured and pushed.
scope: No scientific protocol, claim status, model result, or training state changed. This receipt is a bounded software-test record only.
